text:
Anya D: Quick question — for the internal API facade for model routing, are we leaning towards gRPC everywhere (internal services + sidecars) with a JSON gateway at the edge, or do we keep proto-first but expose JSON across most infra? Need to weigh routing policy, quotas, and how the console surfaces telemetry for rollouts.

Mike R: gRPC internal wins on perf + tight typing. Also easier to enforce method-level routing policies (method -> model variant). But: gateway/transcoding adds complexity and makes browser clients awkward.

Samir K: Agree on perf. Also: quotas are a big one — we currently key quotas by HTTP route. If we switch to gRPC, we need a stable mapping from grpc method to quota key to keep billing/console consistent. Envoy supports route matching on :path but our multi-tenant router will be messy.

Lina (PM): From product/console side: we need per-route P95 latency, error rate, and token-cost breakdown. The console UX expects stable human-readable route labels. Whatever we pick, we must emit a canonical route label that the console can use across rollouts.

Mike R: Could do a small header that the gateway adds: X-Canonical-Route: inference.generateChat.v2. Then all telemetry/quota infra just uses that. Keeps internal transport free to change.

Anya D: That feels pragmatic. But who owns setting that header? Gateway? Model router? Also how to prevent clients from spoofing?

Samir K: Gateway should set it (trusted). Add authz check so header from upstream is ignored and gateway overwrites. In envoy config that looks like:

```yaml
- name: add-canonical-route
  typed_config:
    '@type': type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.header_to_metadata.v3.Config
    request_rules:
      - header: ":path"
        on_header_present:
          metadata_namespace: "routing"
          key: "canonical"
          value: "%REQ(:path)%"
```

Samir K: (toy example) then a small transform layer maps method names to tidy labels and writes X-Canonical-Route.

Lina (PM): Perfect — that lets console show stable names even if we refactor services. For rollouts we can map canonical route -> canary cohort and show delta charts.

Mike R: Telemetry/devops note: tracing spans need to include model_variant and batch_size. If we keep gRPC internal, metadata fields are easy. With JSON we add overhead parsing body for those, which adds cost.

Anya D: About quotas: do we want per-caller-per-route token quotas or per-tenant global quotas? Current infra supports both but per-route adds cardinality. If we keep gRPC, we can enforce per-method quotas in the runtime layer which is cheaper than parsing HTTP paths upstream.

Lina (PM): Product wants per-tenant-per-route limits for enterprise customers. So cardinality is inevitable. We should optimize enforcement path.

Samir K: Proposal: spike this week — implement gRPC internal + edge JSON facade that: 1) normalizes canonical route header, 2) emits telemetry labels for console, 3) services still speak proto on the wire. Keep a fallback config that translates legacy HTTP routes to canonical labels.

Anya D: Sounds good. Can we add a minimal demo: a small proxy that translates browser JSON -> gRPC and sets X-Canonical-Route, plus a dashboard sample that pulls p95 & token cost by canonical label? If we can show end-to-end, we can sell infra to security and product.

Lina (PM): I'll scope the dashboard slice (mock data) and show rollout comparison widget.

Mike R: I'll own the spike infra + envoy snippets. Samir, can you do the quota mapping proto -> canonical?

Samir K: Yup. Will add docs for quota key format: tenant|canonical-route|operation.

ops-bot: Canary deploy: api-facade-spike v0.1 -> canary group (5/5 hosts) :white_check_mark:

Anya D: Nice. One more thing — console telemetry retention/aggregation: when we emit canonical labels, we should also include the original method/path in raw logs for debug. Don't lose fidelity.

Lina (PM): Agreed. Keep raw path in trace/logs but canonical label for UI/quotas.

Mike R: Ok team — plan: 3-day spike, small demo at Fri async sync. If no blockers, we'll iterate on policy enforcement and rollout UX next week. @Lina please add the dashboard mock to the spike ticket.

Lina (PM): Added — https://go/infra-spikes/176886-gprc-facade (placeholder) :rocket:

Anya D: Thanks all.
